about_the_game:
Become an Internet Star in Capybara Hot Tub!

Play as an adorable, fluffy streamer and relax in a hot bath while growing your online fame! Groom your fur, set up your cozy studio, and make your capybara the next viral sensation.

Total Relaxation in a Hot Tub

Take care of your capybara and keep her happy:

  • Soak in a bubbly bath

  • Massage her soft fur

  • Treat her to delicious snacks

Capybara – the Ultimate Internet Star

Don't miss your chance to go viral! Host live streams from the hot tub and win the hearts of your audience:

  • ASMR with juicy berries and tropical drinks

  • Graceful swimming sessions

  • Trendy outfit showcases

Home & Studio with Capybara

  • Customize your streaming studio to match your style

  • Unlock dynamic lighting and special effects for the hot tub

  • Collect the cutest swimming accessories and dress up your capybara like a true superstar!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS 3 (Arch-based)
  • Processor: Zen 2 4c/8t, 2,4–3,5 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 8 RDNA 2 CUs, 1.6GHz
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: SteamOS 3 (Arch-based)
  • Processor: Zen 2 4c/8t, 2.4-3.5GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Zen 2 4c/8t, 2.4-3.5GHz
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-540 or AMD Phenom II X4 940
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 9600 GT, 512 Мб
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4690 or AMD Ryzen 3 1300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960, 4 GB or AMD Radeon R9 380, 4 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
